meta.name: guarantee-generator
meta.description: Create YOUR personal guarantee on top of the product's guarantee for risk reversal. Triggers on: "create a guarantee", "guarantee for my affiliate", "risk reversal", "money back guarantee", "what guarantee can I offer", "reduce buyer risk", "guarantee copy", "how to guarantee", "affiliate guarantee", "personal guarantee", "risk-free offer", "satisfaction guarantee", "results guarantee".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为你的产品或联盟营销创建个性化保证文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是商家或联盟客，想用保证书提高成交率
copy.tagline_en: Create personalized guarantee copy for your products to reduce buyer risk
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a merchant or affiliate looking to boost conversions with guarantees

howto.what: 根据产品信息和你的能力，生成三种个人担保选项（轻触、支持、结果），并推荐最适合的那个，附带可直接粘贴的文案。
howto.when: 当你说“create a guarantee”、“risk reversal”、“money back guarantee”等关键词，或要求降低买家风险时触发。

say.text: 为我的HeyGen推广创建一个担保选项
say.note: 技能会研究产品退款政策，生成三个选项。

say.text: 我能力有限，推荐一个轻量担保
say.note: 技能会推荐Option A，风险最低。

say.text: 设计一个结果担保，结合我的奖金堆
say.note: 技能会根据奖金和价值方程弱点设计担保。

howto.what_en: Generates three personal guarantee options (light, support, results) based on product info and your capacity, recommends the best fit, and provides ready-to-paste copy.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say keywords like "create a guarantee", "risk reversal", "money back guarantee", or ask to reduce buyer risk.

say_en.text: Create a guarantee for my HeyGen promotion
say_en.note: Skill researches refund policy and generates three options.

say_en.text: I have low capacity, recommend a light guarantee
say_en.note: Skill recommends Option A, minimal risk.

say_en.text: Design a results guarantee with my bonus stack
say_en.note: Skill uses bonuses and value equation to design guarantee.
